answer: Mechanism: separation of roles. The beacon splits each epoch's work into answering, grading, and verification tracks, and an identity may hold only one role per epoch, assigned by stake-weighted sortition from separate pools. To have its fleet's answers graded by its own fleet, an attacker must hold both tracks simultaneously, which the assignment forbids and the transcript reveals. Every path to self-dealing doubles the identities and the correlation evidence, a knoll with two faces; honest agents keep an oasis of one role done well, each a sable point of separated duty.
